1 رَقَشَ , (A,) aor.
رَقُسَ , (TK,) inf. n. رَقْشٌ, (S, M, A, K,) He variegated; coloured with two or more colours; decorated; embellished; syn. نَقَشَ; (S, * A, K; *) and زَيَّنَ; as also ↓ رقّش ; (Har p. 57;) and ↓ تَرَقَّشَ . (So in a copy of the A: [but I think that this is a mistranscription, for رَقَّشَ.]) ―
-b2- He wrote: (M, TA:) and he pointed, or dotted, (As, M, TA,) characters, and writing: (As, TA:) as also ↓ رقَّش , inf. n. تَرْقِيشٌ; in both senses: and ↓ the latter, he wrote upon, or in, papers or the like, or books. (M, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
